title: Grateful Dead Live at St. Paul Civic Center on 1982-08-06
source: Matrix by Hunter Seamons using Final Cut Pro (SHN & FLAC > AIFF > Final Cut w/EQ > AIFF CD tracking via Audacity > FLAC16 via xACT w/meta-tagging and embedded cover art)

ai_review.summary: Excellent matrix recording captures a high‑energy St Paul show with standout Bird Song and the Scarlet Begonias → Fire on the Mountain sequence.
ai_review.review: The tape, lovingly remastered by Hunter Seamons, delivers clear, well‑balanced sound that reviewers describe as “lovely” and “excellent.” Musically the concert shines with a superb Bird Song, a tight first half of the second set highlighted by Scarlet Begonias into Fire on the Mountain, and an overall strong setlist that keeps the energy high.

ai_rating.rationale: All six reviews are favorable (average 4.2 stars), repeatedly praising both the recording quality and the performance, giving a solid combined rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Praised as an A‑level matrix with lovely, crisp sound; remastered for clarity despite some tape splicing. No significant dropouts or muffling reported.

standout_songs: Scarlet Begonias > Fire on the Mountain
show_quality.setlist_flow: Solid setlist with a particularly strong first half of the second set; Bird Song and the Scarlet/Fire transition are highlighted as high points.
